notes: CGSS2021 nationally representative mainland-China household survey — newest CGSS release with this questionnaire layout. Crosswalk at scripts/crosswalks/cgss2021.py maps 29 schema dims. Question numbering was restructured vs 2017 (title-case A2/A3_1/A4..., A5 single-select religion, roster A011601-614, A59L employees); verified against the actual CGSS2021.dta. The 2017 D-module batteries (LOT-R optimism, filial duty, govt responsibility, cooking, parental death) and the 2017 internet-attitude items (news minutes, mobile payment, privacy, doomscrolling) do not exist in 2021 -> those dims are not mapped here (faithful nulls). New in 2021: D23_a alcohol, D23_b exercise. 8,148 respondents extracted (29 dims, avg 23.6 grounded dims/persona; validate_extraction.py: 0 errors). Coverage note: E34/P4c trust and D23 items come from ~1/3-sample add-on modules by design.
